name: Manikandan L
tagline: Software Developer with hands-on experience in full-stack web development and data engineering, passionate about building scalable applications and data-driven solutions.
bio: I’m a Software Developer focused on building scalable web applications and data-driven solutions. I work across full-stack development and data engineering, combining modern web technologies with cloud, big data, and distributed processing tools. From crafting responsive, accessible user interfaces to engineering robust event-driven streaming pipelines and medallion data platforms, I build systems that are clean, resilient, and production-ready.
availability: Open for Full-time Roles & Freelance Opportunities

freelanceProject.title: Surya Stores – E-Commerce & Order Management System
freelanceProject.description: Completed a full-stack e-commerce and order management platform for a stationery business, enabling customers to browse products, filter by categories, add items to cart, and submit orders through a responsive web interface.
features: Product management system with category filtering
Shopping cart functionality and seamless order submission
Admin dashboard for product management and order tracking
JWT-based authentication and role-based access control
REST APIs connecting React frontend to Node.js/Express backend
Order notifications dispatched via Email and WhatsApp

projects.title: EventBook – Event Booking & Management System
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Event Platform with Role-Based Portals
projects.description: Full-stack event booking platform where customers browse events, view details, and book tickets, with role-based access for customers and administrators.
features: Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based authorization for customers and administrators
Built an Admin Dashboard for event creation (image upload, pricing, venue, schedule, ticket availability) and booking management
Developed a My Bookings section and integrated REST APIs via Axios with Express.js and MongoDB, with protected routes and role-based navigation

projects.title: Real-Time Order Analytics Streaming Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Event-Driven Data Pipeline with Watermarking & Docker
projects.description: Fully containerized real-time pipeline ingesting and analyzing e-commerce order events using Apache Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming.
features: Built a Kafka producer and a Spark Structured Streaming job to consume and process live order events in real time
Implemented windowed aggregations with watermarking for per-category revenue/order counts, handling late data correctly
Persisted output to checkpointed Parquet and built a live Streamlit dashboard; containerized all services with Docker Compose

projects.title: End-to-End FMCG Data Engineering Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Medallion Architecture & M&A Data Integration
projects.description: Simulated FMCG/retail M&A scenario integrating Parent and Child company sales data into a unified data platform.
features: Architected a 3-layer Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) on AWS S3 and Databricks into analytics-ready tables
Engineered Full Load and Incremental Load pipelines using Delta Lake Merge/Upsert to integrate records without duplication
Built data quality validation logic and orchestrated the pipeline with Databricks Workflows; delivered a KPI dashboard

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.subtitle: WebSocket Instant Messaging Platform
projects.description: A full-stack real-time chat application with instant messaging, online presence tracking, and real-time communication using WebSockets.
features: Bi-directional WebSocket communication for zero-latency instant messaging
User authentication, persistent chat history, and online presence indicators
Responsive, modern UI built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and MongoDB storage
